description.zh: 端到端招聘助手——从岗位画像、JD 撰写、简历筛选、结构化面试题（STAR/情境题）到薪酬对标与 Offer 谈判策略；把招聘从“凭感觉”升级到“有框架、有数据、可复盘”。
description.en: End-to-end recruitment assistant — from job profiling, JD writing, resume screening, structured interview questions (STAR/scenario) to compensation benchmarking and offer negotiation strategies; elevate recruitment from gut-feelings to a framework-driven, data-backed, reviewable process.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你要招什么岗位、有什么候选人资料或简历，我来帮你
welcome_message.en: Tell me what role you're hiring for and share any candidate resumes or profiles — I'll help you

description.zh: 生成一份专业、合规且有吸引力的 JD
description.en: Generate a professional, compliant, and attractive JD

prompt.zh: 请帮我撰写一份 {岗位名称} 的岗位描述（JD），包括岗位目标、核心职责、必备技能、加分技能、薪酬范围、团队介绍和公司福利。要求：结构清晰、吸引目标候选人、不含任何歧视性条款。
prompt.en: Write a job description for the role, covering objectives, core responsibilities, must-have skills, nice-to-haves, compensation range, team intro, and company perks. Must be structured, compelling to target candidates, and free from discriminatory language.

description.zh: 按岗位维度自动打分并输出推荐排序
description.en: Auto-score resumes by job criteria and rank candidates

prompt.zh: 请帮我筛选一批 {岗位名称} 的简历，按以下维度打分（1-5）：学历与经验匹配度、硬技能匹配度、求职动机与稳定性、红旗风险。输出 Top N 推荐名单与每份简历的评分摘要。
prompt.en: Screen resumes for the role using 1-5 scoring on: education/experience fit, hard-skill fit, motivation/stability, and red-flag risks. Output a Top-N shortlist with score summaries.

description.zh: 生成岗位核心能力面试题 + 评分 Rubric
description.en: Generate interview questions + scoring rubric for core competencies

prompt.zh: 请针对 {岗位名称} 的核心能力（领导力、协作、问题解决、冲突处理）设计 6 道结构化面试题，每题包含 STAR 追问框架和 1-5 分评分 Rubric。
prompt.en: Design 6 structured interview questions for the role's core competencies (leadership, collaboration, problem-solving, conflict management). Each question must include a STAR follow-up framework and a 1-5 scoring rubric.

zh: 每个新岗位空缺 24 小时内输出一份含市场薪酬范围与对标公司的 JD 模板
收到 50+ 份简历时按职位要求维度自动打分并输出 Top 10 推荐
候选人进入终面前自动针对岗位核心能力出 6 道结构化面试题+评分 Rubric
en: Within 24 hours of a new opening, output a JD template with market compensation range and benchmarking companies
When 50+ resumes arrive, auto-score by job criteria and output a Top 10 recommendation list
Before a final-round interview, auto-generate 6 structured interview questions + scoring rubric for the role's core competencies
